author: Karl Rock
description:
Travelling through Sindh as a foreigner can be a little more complicated than you might expect.

Outside Karachi, you may have to deal with police checkpoints and escorts, and communication can be difficult if you don’t speak Urdu.

That’s why I recommend travelling with a local guide in interior Sindh. They can communicate with the police, handle the local logistics, and make the whole experience much smoother - leaving you to actually enjoy the journey.

Sindh is absolutely worth exploring. Just having the right local support can make a huge difference.
title: Travel in Sindh Isn’t Simple
